tableCoreAnalysis.provenance: Recorded from independent in-memory graph calculation in this analysis session; no source SQL scan.
notes: Six focal tables are all in the largest 2-core and largest biconnected block; none is an articulation in the induced core.
The 23-table block is an AML candidate; the 11-table block is an AUM score candidate connected through wide_idx_cust_aum_tot_score.
Undirected structural cores do not measure business value.

labelPropagation.method: Asynchronous weighted label propagation; ties keep current label when tied, otherwise seeded random; up to 100 rounds.

fieldAnalysis.rawScope: All published VALUE and CONDITION edges; source identity from platform+dataSource+qualifiedName; target identity via task+writeObservationId WRITES_TABLE
fieldAnalysis.denominator: Distinct columns of all graph-mapped final WRITE_FIELD nodes for the same physical target table, unioned across writes/producers. Not DDL width or per-write coverage.
fieldAnalysis.caveat: VALUE/CONDITION are observed input footprints and do not establish a confirmed cross-task continuation path.

controlAnalysis.scope: DATASET_CONTROL only; final writes; configured plus four exclusions; no self pairs; match global externalRead x finalWrite baseline
controlAnalysis.caveat: This snapshot has FILTER/JOIN/GROUP_BY DATASET_CONTROL; no WINDOW subtype was recorded. Zero recorded WINDOW does not prove absence of SQL windows.
